title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Convinced and Still Correctable
caption:
A godly man holds a hard line on what's true. He holds a soft grip on his own read of everything else.

That's not a contradiction. It's the whole shape of walking humbly with your God: sure of Christ, honest about your own limits, quick to ask where you're wrong.

Ask a brother where you're wrong this week. Actually wait for the answer.

#faith #humility #christianmen #character #manofgod
